a.speaker: voice
a.text: Evening, Miss Moreno. You parked where Harcourt can't see you. Good instincts.

b.speaker: voice
b.text: Room 204 is upstairs, east side. The night manager keeps the office off the lobby. Twenty-odd guests tonight. None of them are guests.

d.speaker: voice
d.text: Because you already know how this scene ends. Wear the star. Hit your mark.
